Title: Delete account (Settings > Security) does nothing - dead button
Steps to Reproduce: 1 Go to Settings > Security. 2 Click Delete account.
Actual Result: Nothing happens - no dialog, no error, no network call. Account not deleted.
Expected Result: Confirm dialog, then account and data removed; login fails afterwards.
QA Comment: No request fires on click - handler not wired.
Business Impact: Users cant remove their own data - GDPR/NDPR risk.
